feature.title: 🚀 Feature: Settlement error handling
feature.body:
## Bounded Context
Settlement domain. Merchant and Operator actors. Payment processor integration boundary.

## User Stories

### Story 1: Surface and recover failed settlements

- As a **Merchant**, I want **failed settlements to be retried and surfaced** so that **I do not lose revenue silently**

#### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Failed settlements are retried up to 3 times before being marked as permanently failed
- [ ] Merchants receive a notification when a settlement fails permanently
- [ ] Operators can view and manually retry failed settlements

#### Scenarios

```gherkin
Scenario: Failed settlement is retried
  Given a settlement attempt has failed
  When the retry runs
  Then the settlement is attempted again and the Merchant balance stays consistent

Scenario: Settlement is marked permanently failed after three retries
  Given a settlement has failed three retry attempts
  When the last retry fails
  Then the settlement is marked as permanently failed

Scenario: Merchant is notified of a permanent settlement failure
  Given a settlement is marked as permanently failed
  When the SettlementPermanentlyFailed event is received
  Then the Merchant receives a failure notification

Scenario: Operator manually retries a failed settlement
  Given an Operator views a permanently failed settlement
  When the Operator requests a retry
  Then a SettlementRetryRequested event is emitted and the settlement is retried

Scenario: Duplicate operator retry is idempotent
  Given an Operator has already requested a retry for a settlement
  When the Operator requests a retry again
  Then no second SettlementRetryRequested event is emitted
```

## Domain Events

- Emits: `SettlementFailed`, `SettlementPermanentlyFailed`, `SettlementRetryRequested`
- Consumes: none

## Trace Plan

1. [x] ☄️ Skeleton — Surface and recover failed settlements: proves the retry path end-to-end (claims: "Failed settlement is retried") #61
